vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 2 of 40. Yea or Aye: 1. Nay or No: 1. Not Voting: 0. stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

party_line.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

override.card_note: Posts from @RepMoylan. The account listed in the public congress-legislators dataset (@JMoylanforGuam) no longer exists; this account carries X's government label and its bio names the member's office.

posts.text: It was great to meet and speak with @SecRubio at a recent @HouseForeignGOP hearing. Sec. Rubio committed to establishing a regional passport office in Guam. I look forward to working more with him as we deliver for the country and Guam! https://t.co/bYwb5qtxU4
It was great hosting Lt. Gov. Josh Tenorio in DC today to discuss the important relationship between Congress and our local government. https://t.co/MptGfehzau
This Police Week and Peace Officer Memorial Day, we remember and honor those who gave their lives and who currently serve to keep our communities safe. https://t.co/i9pORwqT8E
I am proud to co-lead this bill which will ensure our guardsmen, veterans, and service members are treated with dignity and respect. https://t.co/9DRlXDAqUE
Need help with a federal agency? Contact our district office today at (671)922-7673. https://t.co/Gxg5tG10K6
Happy Mothers’s Day to the incredible women who contribute so much to our families, communities, and society! https://t.co/auDaKSH03Q

Today is a wonderful day as we celebrate the election of Pope Leo XIV—the first American pope. I  pray for his success, guidance, and wisdom as he assumes this immense role. May God bless him and may God bless America!

Happy National Teachers Week! Educators play a significant role in shaping our island and the minds of our future generations. Thank you to all teachers for your dedication and commitment. https://t.co/4Tak8zpR6U

Today I testified in front of @HouseSmallBiz urging them to help reopen the Guam SBA office. It was a successful hearing in which my colleagues had the chance to hear about the struggles Guam and the Pacific small businesses face. https://t.co/42TYALTIB8
Thank you to Dr. Sheih for bringing this case to my attention and for looking out for the safety of Guam’s families. https://t.co/OIid3F42ed
https://t.co/sOVVG9hr5B
It’s been a busy month working to improve our island! https://t.co/epcKhqnt9e
It is important that we work to enhance US foreign policy in the Indo-Pacific, and that includes supporting economic activity in Guam. https://t.co/GMrNjaRJko

Our office has worked hard to announce new investments into our national defense capabilities in Guam. These investments made will not only strengthen our capabilities but also reaffirm our commitment to the security of our allies in the Indo-Pacific. https://t.co/Kjdqkq1ZG8

To ensure local veterans have access to quality care in Guam, I wrote to VA Secretary Doug Collin’s asking him to relocate the VA Regional office from Manila to Guam. We will never stop fighting for our veterans! https://t.co/dWr9pvaQJq

Today, the committee on Education and Workforce passed reform to federal higher education programs, which will result in over $330 billion in taxpayer savings within 10 years. These reforms to federal student aid programs will boost student success while safeguarding taxpayer funds.
Small businesses are the backbone of our economy and our office is working hard to reinstate Guam’s SBA office. https://t.co/jy0HJARJfs

Today, our district team assisted the Mangilao Mayor’s office in their TEFAP Food Commodities Distribution. Thank you to the Mayor’s office for working with us and letting us donate food rations to the community! https://t.co/hesPXt7Uyf

Congratulations to everyone who participated in the 2025 Congressional App Challenge! Yesterday I visited St. Anthony Catholic School to present them with certificates for their hard work. https://t.co/gyc7Nmg2Di

I am happy to announce the winners for the 2025 Congressional Art Competition! The first place art will be displayed at the US Capitol and the second place art will be displayed at our district office. https://t.co/mbdEZqhu3x
I met with Andersen Air Force Base leadership and toured their brand new weather radar that our office facilitated the repairs for. It’s great to see our hard work in action! https://t.co/Mha4W68s8K

We worked hard to get our bill HR 877 the “Deliver for Veterans Act” passed the finish line in the House. I continue to advocate for this bill in as it advances through the Senate. https://t.co/TGUny0hrAF

It is with a heavy heart that I join the global community in mourning the loss of His Holiness Pope Francis. His profound dedication to compassion and unity has left a lasting mark on the world. His passing represents a great loss for humanity, as his legacy of love and empathy will continue to impact generations to come.

A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
